title: The Effect of Questionnaire Content on Measures of Pain Intensity, Magnitude of Disability, and Symptoms of Depression in Patients With Arm Illness
brief_summary: The investigators plan a prospective randomized study to see whether negative questions affect measures of mood, pain, or disability. A total of 175 patients will participate at Massachusetts General Hospital.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All new and follow-up patients presenting to the Orthopaedic Hand and Upper Extremity Service
* English fluency and literacy

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant women
* Inability to complete enrollment forms due to any mental status or language problems (e.g. dementia, head injury, overall illness).
